title: SiteShrimp Photo Entry — Quality Mark Assessment variant
description: BCA Quality Mark for Good Workmanship variant per Guide on QM Scheme (Rev 22 May 2025). Internal-finish quality assessment of private residential dwellings. Threshold 85 (tender from 1 Jun 2020) / 80 (before). Tiered Rating: Star 92+, Excellent 90 to <92, Merit 85 to <90 — gated on waterponding pass-rate and window watertightness pass-rate. Severity is reinterpreted as QM impact: Critical = major defect (per QM Guide §2.9), Major = scoring defect, Minor = scoring defect of lesser weightage, Observation = passes assessment. Source: BCA Guide on Quality Mark Scheme, Rev Date 22 May 2025.
x-csv-header-convention: Each property maps 1:1 to a column in the Entries sheet. The 'x-csv-header' field is the exact column header string. Variant columns are appended after the base columns when the project's workCategory is 'Quality Mark Assessment'.

qm_arch_item.description: Verbatim QM Architectural Item from the QM Guide weightage table. The seven items carry edition-dependent weightages — CONQUAS 9th / 2019: Floor 24%, Internal Wall 15%, Ceiling 15%, Door 12%, Window 12%, Component 11%, M&E Fittings 11%. CONQUAS 2022: Floor 20%, Internal Wall 13%, Ceiling 7%, Door 18%, Window 13%, Component 20%, M&E Fittings 9%.

qm_defect_category.description: Verbatim QM Defect Category from the QM Guide weightage table. Hollowness applies only to Floor / Internal Wall. Roughness applies only to Ceiling. Jointing applies only to Floor / Internal Wall / Ceiling. Joints & Gap / Material & Damages / Functionality / Accessories Defects apply only to Door / Window / Component / M&E Fittings.

qm_major_defect.description: Flagged true when the defect matches any of the six QM Major Defect examples per QM Guide §2.9: (a) missing/broken accessories for assessed architectural items, (b) cracked/chipped/broken window panes, shower screens, mirrors, glass items, (c) visibly cracked tiles/stones/timber doors/timber flooring/ceiling boards/painted-wall cracks, (d) functionally deficient doors / windows / wardrobes / cabinets / taps / water closets / switches, (e) fan-coil unit leakage, water seepage through walls or windows, (f) misaligned door frame with verticality tolerance > 3 mm per door frame height. Used to drive the QM Tiered Rating downgrade rule and to surface major defects on REPORT exports.

qm_inspection_type.description: QM assessment type the photo evidence belongs to. The QM Guide specifies four In-Process inspections (waterproofing to bathrooms, stone/tiling, timber flooring, window installation), two waterponding tests (bathrooms 25mm × 24h finished flooring, and roofs/planter boxes/spaces above living-bedrooms 24h on finished flooring), Internal Finish Assessment (covers all locations except household shelters), and the CONQUAS-sampling Window Watertightness retest path.

qm_conquas_edition.description: Which CONQUAS edition the QM weightage table follows for this project. CONQUAS 2022 applies to construction tenders called from 1 June 2022. Earlier projects use the CONQUAS 9th Edition / 2019 weightage. QM threshold is 85 for projects with tender from 1 Jun 2020, otherwise 80.

qm_dwelling_unit_no.description: Identifier of the dwelling unit the photo was taken in (block + unit number, e.g. 'Blk 12 #08-103' or '#08-103'). The QM threshold (85 / 80) and Tiered Rating Avg QM Unit Score are computed per dwelling unit, so unit-level tagging is required for any aggregation. When unit number is not yet allocated (mock-up unit / construction phase), use the project-internal designation visible in the photo.

qm_household_shelter.description: Flagged true when the photo is taken inside a household shelter (HS). The QM Internal Finish Assessment explicitly EXCLUDES household shelters per QM Guide §2.4(1) — flagged photos must be excluded from scoring even though they may carry valid defects. Defaults to false.
